game.title: Prey
game.renderer: Direct3D 11 - a dxgi.dll proxy loads in-process; the device calls were not recorded [inferred-static 2026-09-17]
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-17 on RTX (home PC, 3440x1440 desktop): title -> main menu -> Options -> Video by keyboard, windowed 1280x720 via system.cfg, closed with WM_CLOSE. Exe Binaries\Danielle\x64\Release\Prey.exe; the renderer is in PreyDll.dll. The user has a 31 h campaign save (see hazards).

input.api: keyboard (synthetic key presses); mouse clicks on menu items do NOT register
api_notes: Mouse clicks on menu items did nothing (n=2). Drive the menus with the keyboard.

bindings.action: open 'Apply changes?' in the Video tab, then confirm it
confirm the 'Confirm Video Settings' countdown (~5 s)
bindings.notes: Neither Enter, E nor a mouse click confirmed it in time; it reverted three times.

states.name: main_menu
states.detect: Vertical list: CONTINUE, LOAD GAME, NEW GAME, NEW GAME+, OPTIONS, LAUNCH MOONCRASH, EXIT.

states.name: options_video
states.detect: Options tabs; Video has Monitor, Resolution (dropdown), Display Mode (Windowed / Fullscreen / Borderless Windowed).

states.name: confirm_video_settings
states.detect: 'Confirm Video Settings' with a ~5 s countdown that reverts the change.

steps: with the game CLOSED, back up <game>\system.cfg (system.cfg.bak-2026-09-17 on RTX)
append three lines: r_Fullscreen=0, r_Width=1280, r_Height=720
routes.notes: Window 1296x759, client 1280x720 [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. The in-game Video route is disproved.

steps: PostMessage WM_CLOSE to the game's top-level window

config_files: <game>\system.cfg - CryEngine cvars read at start; the three r_ lines give a window [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. r_Fullscreen 0 = window, 1 = fullscreen, 2 = fullscreen windowed, per the cvar help text in PreyDll.dll [inferred-static 2026-09-17].
Saved Games\Arkane Studios\Prey\ - profiles and saves. The engine also names a %USER%/game.cfg, which does not exist on RTX [inferred-static 2026-09-17].
entry_points.logs: <game>\Game.log, rewritten each launch; it lists the r_Width / r_Height / r_Fullscreen values in effect.
entry_points.proxy_dll: dxgi.dll beside Prey.exe (logging, full export). Needs early-call handling - see hazards.

hazards.hazard: NEW GAME sits two rows under CONTINUE, and the user has a 31 h campaign
hazards.notes: Never press Down blind on the main menu. Verify the highlight before Enter. Whether a new game would touch the existing save is untested - do not test it.

hazards.hazard: Video settings revert unless confirmed within ~5 s, and no synthetic input confirms them
hazards.notes: Enter, E and a mouse click all failed (3 reverts). Use system.cfg with the game closed.

hazards.hazard: The dxgi proxy is called before its DllMain runs
hazards.notes: Windows' AcGenral compatibility shim calls dxgi SetAppCompatStringPointer before the proxy's DllMain has loaded the real dxgi.dll (found in x64dbg). A proxy must resolve the real function on that early call instead of jumping through an empty table.

hazards.hazard: A Windows Firewall prompt on the first run steals focus
hazards.notes: A Windows Defender Firewall 'allow access' dialog appeared on the first launch on this machine and took focus from the game. The main session pressed Cancel; answering it is left to the user. Losing focus can minimise a fullscreen game.

disproved.claim: Confirm the 'Confirm Video Settings' countdown with Enter, E or a mouse click
